environment.description: Same Ktor webhook-gateway deployed in 'commerce-prod' namespace on GKE 1.28 with Istio 1.20. Mesh-wide PeerAuthentication enforces STRICT mTLS. An AuthorizationPolicy in the 'vault-system' namespace specifies: source principals must match 'cluster.local/ns/vault-system/sa/*' for any workload in that namespace. A second AuthorizationPolicy (DENY action) is applied mesh-wide at the root namespace (istio-system) with a rule matching source namespace 'commerce-prod' and destination namespace not in ['commerce-prod', 'istio-system', 'monitoring'] — effectively a default-deny for cross-namespace egress from commerce-prod to sensitive namespaces. GKE Workload Identity is bound so the metadata endpoint returns only the mapped IAM service account token (roles/logging.logWriter only). Pod has annotation 'traffic.sidecar.istio.io/excludeOutboundIPRanges' NOT set, meaning all egress is captured by Envoy sidecar.
